description: The line plot titled "Ablation Study on HateXplainer" illustrates the performance metrics of different model variants of a hate speech detection system. The x-axis represents the model variants, which include "Model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The x-axis is labeled with these model variant names and is arranged in a categorical manner. The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and represents the performance metric, which is a percentage. The y-axis scale is linear, and the tick labels are evenly spaced, although the exact range is not specified. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different performance metric: Precision, Recall, F1-score, and a metric labeled as "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The lines are color-coded and marked with circles at each data point. The "Model (Ours)" line starts at 65.78% for Precision, dips to 59.64% for Recall, and peaks at 62.63% for F1-score. The "w/o Prompt" line starts at 61.06% for Precision, dips to 60.16% for Recall, and peaks at 62.22% for F1-score. The "w/o Augmentation" line starts at 63.75% for Precision, dips to 59.17% for Recall, and peaks at 64.06% for F1-score. The "w/o Attention" line starts at 59.67% for Precision, dips to 57.74% for Recall, and peaks at 64.06% for F1-score. The "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" line starts at 56.82% for Precision, dips to 59.17% for Recall, and peaks at 57.74% for F1-score. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions; it simply presents the performance metrics for each model variant.
